title: CFA lane 2: financial statement analysis (ratios and decomposition)
mission: Curate atomic, reusable financial-statement-analysis relationships: activity, liquidity, solvency and profitability ratios, DuPont decomposition, growth and common-size arithmetic, each with explicit statement basis (GAAP/IFRS where it matters) and period scope. Ratio arithmetic only; continue through successive batches with no company-analysis chain required.
priorities: Activity ratios: inventory, receivables and payables turnover with stated averaging convention
Liquidity ratios: current, quick and cash ratios with stated statement scope
Solvency ratios: debt-to-equity, debt-to-assets and interest coverage with stated debt definition
Profitability ratios: gross, operating and net margins plus return on assets with stated income definition
Return on equity and the DuPont three-step and five-step decompositions as separate records
Sustainable growth rate from retention and ROE with stated assumptions
Common-size and index-number arithmetic with stated base
Cash conversion cycle from turnover components with stated period convention
boundaries: This lane owns statement-ratio arithmetic; valuation, capital budgeting, fixed income, derivatives and portfolio records belong to lanes 1 and 3-6.
Do not resubmit the 14 covered TVM-family IDs as new coverage; record overlaps instead (see curator brief).
Ratios are pure arithmetic on stated inputs; record whether each input is Point-in-time, average, trailing or forward, and never mix them silently.
Exclude accounting-standard interpretation, audit judgments, forecasts and investment recommendations.
GAAP/IFRS differences are scope notes on the record, not separate models, unless the formula itself differs with its own source.
starter_sources: Owner excerpt packet for this lane (discovery leads with exact PDF locators; corroborate every record against a directly inspected accessible source).
A public accounting/finance text with the same ratios (for example OpenStax Principles of Finance or Accounting); record exact book, edition and section, never cite a root URL as evidence.
special_checks: Every ratio input states its measurement basis (average vs ending balance, trailing vs annualized income) in meaning, context and guards.
Guard zero denominators (zero equity, zero sales, zero average balances) as domain exclusions with rejection cases.
DuPont steps are separate records sharing quantity definitions, not one end-to-end scenario formula.
Test a boundary case (zero debt, zero profit, single-period averaging) explicitly.
integration_expectation: Most meanings (current_ratio, debt_to_equity, return_on_equity, dupont_component and similar) are new and require extension; all seed forms are scalar ratios and fit the engine once meanings exist. Currency amounts never convert implicitly; ratio outputs are dimensionless. Never relabel a margin as a discount rate to force execution.
coverage_guidance: Priorities are seeds, not a finite checklist. Continue into adjacent FSA readings inside the boundaries, selecting independently reusable relationships. Save multiple bounded batches without waiting for owner review. Check supplied inventory and prior returns for equivalent relationships and conflicting IDs. Record out-of-format discoveries as deferred with exact sources and missing capabilities; do not force chains or dilute quality for a quota.
